## Tube corrections, spine prefixes and the cold reset: what was measured

Sources: the 63 original demonstrations plus 154 tube branches (`mpc_spine_tube_0001/tracking/episodes`: one spine control perturbed by L2 .01/.03/.1, then the reference-tracking CEM to a verified success; the 12 branches at control 13 carry no correction rows and were skipped). BC rows: every correction row of the branches (979), every spine row (14, also pinned per state), and all rows of the originals outside shared states (1,996 rows, 1,953 distinct states, 0 conflicting labels). Episode stream: 40 % spine prefixes k = 0-13, the rest end-suffix episodes over all 217 sources, of which (in `0087`) half of the branch episodes hand off at the first corrected state (key `c`). 30-trial frozen evaluation of online_4000 at the cold reset and every spine prefix (`frozen_checkpoint_evaluation_0001/results_shared/bootstrap_variant_0088_ms_spine193_tube_noperturbhandoff_from84/online_4000.json`):

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `0084` online_4000 (inherited) | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 1/30 D | 30/30 D | 30/30 D | 30/30 D | 30/30 D |
| `0087` online_4000 (handoffs at corrected states) | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 1/30 | 1/30 | 3/30 | 2/30 | 1/30 | 18/30 | 30/30 D | 30/30 D | 30/30 D |
| `0088` online_4000 (ablation) | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 1/30 | 6/30 | 5/30 D | 4/30 | 17/30 D | 29/30 D | 30/30 D | 30/30 D |

Online training: `0087` 0 successes in 154 episodes from spine prefixes 0-7, 4/20 at k8, 3/18 at k9, 76/79 at k10-k13, and 44/136 from corrected states; `0088` 0/83 at k0-k4, 1/15, 1/14, 2/16, 1/22 at k5-k8, 8/24 at k9, 66/72 at k10-k13. In-run, the two evaluated branches are completed from their last 1-3 corrected states only (`track_..._j4_r0300_d0` s3 3/3 from online_2000 on in both stages; `j7_r0100_d1` s1 3/3) and seed_100 lost lengths 2-3 (P3 P3 at baseline, 1/3 and 0/3 at online_4000 in `0087`).

**Reading.** The corrections did not become a feedback law in 4,000 updates: the stochastic rates at prefixes 5-9 rose from 0 to 1-6 of 30 (the first non-zero cells before prefix 9 in this family) while the deterministic frontier stayed at prefix 10 and became unreliable there (18/30 and 17/30 against 30/30 inherited), and no cold-reset trial succeeded. A supervised-only probe on the same rows (`frozen_checkpoint_evaluation_0001/spine_probe/bc_tube_probe.py`: mean-only BC from the `0084` actor on the 993 spine and correction rows, 8,000 steps) does not even fit them: median residual 0.49 per row (spine rows 0-3 at 0.7-1.7) with the loss still falling slowly, and its closed-loop behaviour is the stages' (cold fails, spine prefixes 9-13 pass, 9 of 24 corrected states completed, all near the end). With corrections that differ by 0.3-0.9 between states 0.1-0.3 apart, the 256x256 actor cannot represent the law from one branch per perturbed state, and the SAC objective on top of it moves the frontier by the amount the chaos of the open-loop sequences allows. A longer fit (60,000 steps, lr 3e-4; `spine_probe/bc_tube_s60k.log`) reaches a median residual of 0.10 per row but leaves the spine's first four rows at 0.85-1.92, and in closed loop it is worse than the stages: cold fails after 2 controls, spine prefixes 1-10 all fail deterministically (11-13 pass), 5 of 24 corrected states completed. Fitting the corrections more closely therefore does not produce feedback competence; it erodes the pinned end-of-turn behaviour. No cold-reset trial succeeded; nothing here is primitive-eligible.

## Scope

All collected rows are assisted or demonstration-mixed and ineligible for primitive export; cold-reset trials decide deployment eligibility and none succeeded in this stage.
